data.name: Ajaatshatru
data.long_meaning: Ajaatshatru is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'aja' (invincible) and 'shatru' (enemy). The name signifies someone who is invincible and unconquerable, someone who cannot be defeated in battle. This name was given to King Ajatshatru of Magadha, who ruled around the 5th century BCE. He is most famously known for his victory over the powerful kingdom of Hastinapur.
